description: Before paying an x402 402 response, check that its payment requirements (payTo, amount, asset, network, resource) were signed by the seller and not altered in transit by a proxy, CDN, SDK or another tool. x402 v2 carries the requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header (base64 JSON): pass either the decoded JSON or the raw base64 value as body. Pass expect:{resource_url, payTo, amount} — the URL you actually requested and the address and amount you are about to pay. verified:true requires expect.resource_url: it must match the quote's resource (same https origin and path) and the key must come from /.well-known/oceanalt-keys.json on that origin, because the resource and key location inside a quote are part of what is being checked. Without it the result is verified:false with reason_code origin_unanchored, and signature_valid says whether the signature itself checks out. reason_code no_signature means the seller does not sign (unprotected, not necessarily malicious); digest_mismatch or signature_invalid means the response was tampered with — do not pay; resource_mismatch means the quote is for a different URL (origin or path) from the one you requested — do not pay; invalid_input means expect was not understood (only resource_url, payTo and amount are read), so nothing was checked. Keys are fetched without following redirects.

body.description: The decoded PAYMENT-REQUIRED header JSON (object), or the raw base64 header value (string).

expect.description: What you requested and are about to pay; checked against the signed fields.

resource_url.description: The https URL you actually requested. Needed for verified:true.

keys_url.description: Check the signature against a key at this https URL instead of the one named in the quote. A key that is not at /.well-known/oceanalt-keys.json on the resource's origin is checked mathematically (signature_valid) but does not make the result verified.

name: verify_payment_requirements
title: Verify a signed x402 402 response (free)
